thread.title: Dow Jones, S&P 500, Nasdaq Jump As China Trade War Fears Ease

author: KEN SHREVE
title: Dow Jones, S&P 500, Nasdaq Jump As China Trade War Fears Ease
text:
The Dow Jones industrial average powered higher by around 1.2% early Monday after Treasury Secretary Steve Mnuchin on Sunday calmed fears of a potential China trade war.
X The S&P 500 added 0.8% and the Nasdaq composite picked up 1%. FAANG stocks performed in line with the indexes in early trading. Facebook ( FB ), Amazon.com ( AZMN ), Netflix ( NFLX ) and Google parent Alphabet ( GOOGL ) showed gains of 0.8% to 2%.
Apple ( AAPL ) added 1% to 188.50. Resistance has appeared near 190, but the stock continues to hold gains after a breakout from a double-bottom base. The buy point was 179.04, 10 cents above its April 17 intraday high of 178.94.
Shares of Micron Technology ( MU ) jumped 4% after the company raised its earnings and sales guidance for the current quarter.
For the bulls, the strength in the major stock indexes was good to see after the Nasdaq composite marked a mild distribution day Friday. Signs of institutional selling have been more prominent in the S&P 500 in recent weeks, but the market remains in a confirmed uptrend until proven otherwise.
The Russell 2000 small-cap index notched its third-straight record closing high Friday. The iShares Russell 2000 ( IWM ) fund added 0.6% in early trade.
GE, Boeing, Caterpillar Lead Dow Jones Early leaders in the Dow included General Electric ( GE ). Shares were up 2% on news the industrial conglomerate is selling its transportation business to Wabtec ( WAB ). The reported price tag is $11.1 billion.
Dow components Boeing ( BA ), Caterpillar ( CAT ) and Intel ( INTC ) also did well with gains of around 2%.

Please contact customer service CLOSE In other merger news, regional bank Fifth Third Bancorp ( FITB ) slumped more than 6% on news it's buying MB Financial ( MBFI ) for around $4.7 billion. Shares of MB Financial soared 14% on the news.
In the real estate investment trust space, LaSalle Hotel Properties ( LHO ) jumped 6% on news Blackstone Group is buying it for $4.8 billion. LaSalle is a member of Monday's REIT Leaders screen.
After the close, watch for earnings from Leaderboard name Pure Storage ( PSTG ). Shares popped more than 2% in early trading. It's been holding gains after a breakout over a 21.43 buy point.
Retailers have a busy week of earnings ahead. Reports are due Tuesday from Kohl's ( KSS ), TJX Companies ( TJX ) and Urban Outfitters ( URBN ).
